map.圆脸（长宽比≈1、颧弓宽≈下颌宽）宜用侧分、顶部蓬松拉长纵向视觉，避免齐刘海与贴: A round face (length-to-width ratio about 1, zygomatic width about equal to jaw width) suits a side part with volume on top to elongate the vertical line, and should avoid blunt bangs and short styles that cling to the face. In the match score the "vertical elongation" dimension carries the highest weight, which recommends a layered collarbone cut.
map.怎么判断自己是圆脸还是方脸？: How do I tell whether I have a round or a square face?
map.圆脸棱角柔和、长宽接近；方脸下颌角明显、线条硬朗。量颧弓宽与下颌宽，差值小且下颌: A round face has soft angles with length and width close to equal; a square face has clear jaw corners and hard lines. Measure zygomatic width against jaw width — a small difference combined with a square jaw usually means a square face.
map.seven 种脸型都适用同一套规则吗？: Do all seven face shapes follow the same rules?
map.否。椭圆脸最百搭，其余脸型靠「扬长避短」：长脸增横向体积、圆脸拉纵向、方脸柔化下: No. An oval face suits almost anything, while the rest rely on playing up strengths and softening flaws: add width for long faces, add length for round faces, soften the jaw for square faces and narrow a wide forehead for heart faces. The rules differ.
